1.text: Ikamba ry'ubwibone bw'abasinzi bo mu Befurayimu rizabona ishyano, n'ururabyo rw'ubwiza bw'icyubahiro cye rurabye ruri mu mutwe w'ikibaya kirumbuka cy'abagushwa na vino, na rwo rubone ishyano.

2.text: Dore Uwiteka afite umunyamaboko w'intwari, ni we uzabakubita hasi cyane nk'amahindu y'urubura, nk'amashahi arimbura n'amazi menshi y'umwuzure arenga inkombe.

3.text: Maze ikamba ry'ubwibone bw'abasinzi bo mu Befurayimu rizakandagirwa.

4.text: Kandi ururabyo rw'ubwiza bw'icyubahiro cye rurabye rwo mu mutwe w'ikibaya kirumbuka, na rwo ruzamera nk'imbuto y'umutini inetse mbere icyi kitarasohora. Uyibonye arayisoroma, yabona igeze mu ntoki ze akayiyongobeza rwose.

5.text: Uwo munsi Uwiteka Nyiringabo azabera abantu be barokotse ikamba ry'icyubahiro n'umurimbo,

6.text: n'uwicara ku ntebe agaca imanza azamubera umwuka uca imanza zitabera, kandi abantu be azababera imbaraga baneshe urugamba rugeze mu marembo.

7.text: Ariko n'Abayuda na bo baradandabiranywa na vino, igisindisha kirabayobeje. Umutambyi n'umuhanuzi baradandabiranywa n'igisindisha, vino ibamazeho bayobejwe n'igishindisha. Iyo bagiye guhanura baradandabirana, iyo bagiye guca imanza barategwa.

8.text: Ameza yose yuzuyeho ibirutsi n'imyanda, nta heza na hato.

9.text: Azigisha nde ubwenge? Kandi uwo azamenyesha ubutumwa ni nde? Ni abavuye ku ibere bacutse?

10.text: Kuko ibye ari ugutoza itegeko rikurikirwa n'irindi, itegeko ku itegeko, umurongo ku murongo, n'umurongo ku murongo, aha bikeya, hariya bikeya.

11.text: Ahubwo azavuganira n'ubu bwoko mu kanwa k'abanyamahanga b'urundi rurimi,

12.text: ubwo bwoko ni bwo yabwiye ati “Uku ni ko kuruhuka mureke urushye aruhuke, aho ni ho buruhukiro.” Ariko banga kumva.

13.text: Ni cyo gituma kuri bo ijambo ry'Uwiteka rizaba itegeko ku itegeko, umurongo ku murongo, n'umurongo ku murongo, aha bikeya, hariya bikeya, bagende bagwe ngazi bavunike, bategwe bafatwe.

14.text: Nuko rero nimwumve ijambo ry'Uwiteka mwa bakobanyi mwe, bategeka ubu bwoko buri i Yerusalemu.

15.text: Mugira ngo “Twasezeranye isezerano n'urupfu”, kandi ngo “Twuzuye n'ikuzimu. Ibyago nibisandara bigahitanya igihugu, ntibizatugeraho kuko twiboneye ubuhungiro mu binyoma tukaba twihishe mu buryarya.”

16.text: Ni cyo gitumye Umwami Imana ivuga iti “Dore ndashyira muri Siyoni ibuye ry'urufatiro ryageragejwe, ibuye rikomeza impfuruka ry'igiciro cyinshi rishikamye cyane, kandi uwizera ntazahutiraho.

17.text: Kandi imanza zitabera ni zo nzagira umugozi ugera, no gukiranuka nzakugira timazi.”Amahindu azatsemba ibinyoma muhungiramo, kandi amazi azasendera mu bwihisho.

18.text: Maze isezerano mwasezeranye n'urupfu rizapfa, kandi ubumwe mufitanye n'ikuzimu ntibuzahama, ahubwo ibyago nibisandara bigahitanya igihugu, buzabakandagirira hasi.

19.text: Uko bizajya binyuramo bizabafata, kuko bizajya binyuramo uko bukeye ku manywa na nijoro, kandi kumenya ubutumwa kuzaba gutera ubwoba gusa.

20.text: Erega, urutara ni rugufi umuntu atarambirizaho, kandi ikirago ni intambure kitakwira umuntu!

21.text: Uwiteka azahaguruka nk'uko yahagurutse ku musozi Perasimu, azarakara nk'uko yarakariye mu kibaya cy'i Gibeyoni ngo akore umurimo we, ari wo murimo we w'inzaduka, uwo murimo we w'inzaduka azawusohoza.

22.text: Nuko mwe kugumya gukobana, kugira ngo ingoyi zanyu zitarushaho gukanaga, kuko numvise yuko ibyo Umwami Uwiteka Nyiringabo yagambiriye ari ukumaraho isi yose.

23.text: Nimutege amatwi munyumve, nimwumvirize mwumve amagambo yanjye.

24.text: Urimira kuzabiba, ahora arima iteka, ahora acoca amasinde iteka?

25.text: Iyo amaze kuyasanza ntaherako akamisha uburo, akabiba kumino, akabiba ingano mu mirongo, na sayiri akayibiba ahayikwiriye, akabiba na kusemati ku mbibi zaho?

26.text: Kuko Imana ye imwerekēra ikamwigisha neza.

27.text: Uburo ntibuhuzwa imihuzo y'ubugi, na kumino ntihonyozwa uruziga rw'igare, ahubwo uburo buhuzwa inkoni, na kumino ihuzwa inshyimbo.

28.text: Ingano z'umutsima umuntu ntiyahora azihura gusa ahubwo arazihera, kandi nubwo uruziga rw'igare rye n'inzara z'amafarashi ye bizihonyora, ntazisya ngo azinoze.

29.text: N'ibyo na byo bituruka ku Uwiteka Nyiringabo, umujyanama utangaza agasumbya abantu bose ubwenge.
